note: PAGE_INVENTORY §3 (2026-09-06 Wave H). A–Z directory. Live counts on the rows, doors. Not a mini-Bend KPI Instrument. Caption carries the region count and months-of-supply verdict. tasteReview.evaluator: npx tsx scripts/taste-evaluate.ts cities --builder claude-opus-5-5 --evaluator claude --url http://127.0.0.1:3311/cities --shots <the 8 files below>. The grok CLI and the Cursor CLI are missing in this sandbox, so the judge is the chain's claude link (claude CLI, sonnet, subscription): three scorings of these shots in one call, recorded exactly as returned, no re-roll. The builder (the listing-dial integration lane, claude-opus-5-5) is not the judge.

shotSpec.capture: node scripts/take-route-shots.mjs cities http://127.0.0.1:3311/cities --states 'combo-open=[data-taste=city-combo] input!click,homes=.cities-fold__homes,homes-open=.cities-fold__homes .v3-dial__step--next@.cities-fold__homes!click'. First viewport, scale 1, palette-quantized, against the integrated listing-dial tree's own next build + next start (2026-09-25).

tasteReview.beats: Zillow's Bend homes directory (zillow.com/bend-or/) has no cross-city price comparison at all — this page's live median-price map overlaying 15 Central Oregon cities and the Bend-vs-region months-of-supply readout genuinely beat it on data depth. But the comparison control itself (plain bordered input, a flat text list of three cities on open) is flatter than the catalog combobox it's supposed to be adapted from, and the homes carousel is a stock portal gallery Zillow's own map search already beats on interactivity.

defects.section: OVERLAY A CITY AGAINST THE REGION combobox (combo-open shots)
defects.finding: Opening the control reveals a static bordered box with three plain-text rows (Bend / La Pine / Madras, each with tiny caption stats) — no morph animation, no icon, no visual weighting; it reads as a cream box wearing a search icon, not the catalog combobox interaction.

defects.section: City rows inside the opened overlay combobox
defects.finding: Each city's months-of-supply ("4.2 mo", "9.6 mo", "6.4 mo") is stated as bare text beside the name with no bar or mark showing where it falls on the seller/balanced/buyer scale — the same bare-numeral problem the class reference calls out for the old list, just moved into the dropdown.

Median-price callout bubbles collide with city-name labels ("$484k" overlaps "Redmond", "Sisters" is crossed by a neighboring bubble, "Prineville"/"$6.7M" tags overlap at the right edge), and on mobile the map is cropped mid-label ("Powell Bu…") before the fold ends — a legibility break, not a stylistic choice.

defects.section: Page-level section rhythm: Central Oregon cities → Cities on the map → Overlay a city
defects.finding: Three consecutive sections repeat the identical eyebrow-caps-label → bold serif heading → content-block shape with no change in width, density, or framing between them, so the page reads as a stack of interchangeable modules rather than a composed page.

The location marker on the aerial listing photo is a plain solid-red teardrop pin, visually identical to Google Maps' own default marker, which undercuts the brand's own map identity used elsewhere on the page.

tasteReview.verdict: This is a competent, on-brand directory page — navy/cream/Amboqia hold, the city tiles and price-overlay map are a real step up from the bare list the reference file names as the prior failure, and the MoS verdict text matches its own thresholds. But demoMatch is false: the 'overlay a city' control is a static bordered box with a flat text list, not the catalog combobox's morphing interaction, and the homes carousel is an unremarkable portal gallery. Craft slips where the map labels collide and where a generic Google-style pin appears on a listing photo. Correct and dull rather than breathtaking.
tasteReview.rebaselineReason: evaluatorModel differs: the prior mark was grok-4.6; this sandbox has no grok or Cursor CLI, so the judge chain answered on its claude link (claude-sonnet-5). The new mark is the floor on this instrument.

contentFloor.note: No-regression floor (ci:route-content-floor). A build under any number here fails before the evaluator runs. Lower a number only by hand, in the same commit, with the reason. heroImageNatural LOWERED 2043 -> 1382 (2026-09-23, PR #352 blocker; same root cause PR #351 found on oregon-city/place-type-community): the 2026-09-12 seed read heroImageWidth 120 / heroImageNatural 2271, which is exactly public/images/brand/logo-horizontal-navy-transparent.png (2271x454), the header wordmark, winning the widest-in-fold comparison on a page with no photographic hero. The /cities directory (SITE-161 fold: photo + name + live count in the first viewport) now puts a real city photo inside 1200px, rendered wider than the 120px logo, and that photo is delivered at 1536px natural (measured in PR #352 CI runs 35826352263 and 35860657259, identical both times). 1382 = floor(1536 * 0.9), the gate's own 0.9 tolerance on the real photo instead of the logo asset.
